verdict.rationale: Insomnia (part of Kong's product suite) explicitly supports collections and organizations for team sharing: 'Insomnia organizations allows users to share collections and environments safely and securely with their colleagues,' plus org invite features and import/export of collections. However, evidence doesn't confirm real-time sync mechanics, conflict resolution, or workspace-level sync details, and community commentary notes friction (account requirement, bloat complaints) suggesting some UX pain around collaboration. Missing for 10: detail on sync architecture/real-time updates, independent validation of shared-workspace reliability, and enterprise-scale collaboration evidence.
